title: DIO time freshness is caller-stamped instead of receipt-stamped
description: Correctness/security review: DioTimeVerifier.verify accepts caller-supplied observed_monotonic. A valid receipt can be held indefinitely and then verified with the current time, resetting packet age to zero and defeating max_sample_age_s. Stamp reception time inside the LinkLayer-issued receipt or use a verifier-owned trusted monotonic clock with no caller override; add delayed-verification expiry tests.
